name: Restaurant Dream
summary:
Restaurant dream let the player build his own restaurant empire. The player can choose the place, the style (there are 4 kind of different restaurants to choose which one will you use), the staff (waitress, cook, etc.) and you can also buy new items to improve the quality of the service and meals, the player can also hire staff of restaurant rivals or other that are avaliables in the market.

Depending of the player answers to the different questions sometimes during the different weeks there will be some events involving the player staff and other restaurants staffs, the player can also date some of his staff.
